name: Brainrot Seas
desc:
This game is in beta testing! Features and content are subject to change!

Please be kind to the game, we are just seeing if people are interested in the idea!

🧠🌊 Welcome to Brainrot Seas!

The Brainrots took over Roblox. Harness powerful Rots, combine elements, and fight back.

How to Play:
⚓ Assemble your Brainrot crew! Collect unique Brainrots, each with their own powerful element.
🔥💧⚡ Master elemental combos! Mix elements to unleash devastating chain reactions in battle.
⚔️ Fight enemies & bosses! Use strategy, timing, and team synergy to dominate every encounter.
🌍 Explore the open seas! Discover hidden islands, rare Brainrots, and secret treasures.
📈 Upgrade & evolve your squad! Strengthen your team to become the strongest Brainrot Captain alive!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
